description: Secret scanning recognizes project-scoped and legacy OpenAI token shapes
prompt: tools/secret_scan.py is the pre-commit secret check. Review flagged two problems with it last week: a real OpenAI API key went through unnoticed, and it is noisy on the short placeholder strings our documentation uses. Fix it so it recognises the OpenAI API key formats currently in circulation and stays quiet on short placeholders. Keep the CLI contract: the candidate string arrives in argv and the process exits non-zero when a secret is found.
prompt_withholds: Why the key was missed. The old prompt said 'misses long project-scoped OpenAI tokens because their project prefix contains an extra hyphen' — that is the patch, dictated. The new prompt names the symptom, not the cause.
scaffold_note: Deliberately empty. No rule file or prompt in this repo states the secret-scanning contract; the only artefact that encodes it is .agents/harness/hook_guard.py's pattern table (production code, and copying it would hand the agent the answer regex). Declaring a rule here would fake a measurement.
grading_notes: Purely behavioural: the candidate scanner is executed against two real token shapes and three placeholders. No prose is scored.
measurement_limit: CANNOT MEASURE THE SCAFFOLD, BY DESIGN. scaffold_files is empty (see scaffold_note), so this task's arms are byte-identical and its delta is definitionally zero. It is kept as a floor check that the graders discriminate at all, and the harder prompt makes that floor meaningful; it is not evidence about the envelope.

fake.good_response: Scanner covers project-prefixed and legacy long tokens without matching short placeholders.
